items.source: A single file that has changed.
A collections of files from a specific source directory that have changed.
items.translation: 来自特定源目录且已更改的文件集合。

items.source: Factory used to create new FileSystemWatcher instances.
items.translation: 用于创建新FileSystemWatcher实例的工厂。

items.source: Repository used by FileSystemWatcher to save file/directory snapshots across restarts.
items.translation: 由 FileSystemWatcher` 使用的存储库，用于在重启之间保存文件/目录快照。

items.source: Class to watch the local filesystem for changes.
items.translation: 用于监视本地文件系统变化的类。

items.source: Callback interface when file changes are detected.
items.translation: 文件变更检测时的回调接口。

items.source: Watches specific directories for file changes.
items.translation: 监视特定目录的文件更改。
